text: This report seeks approval from City Council, as the approving authority under the Expropriations Act, to expropriate the 'Right of Way' Easement interest in favour of the property municipally known as 40 Avondale Avenue located over part of 44 Avondale Avenue, being City Owned Lands.

City Council on January 31 and February 1, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the expropriation of the 'Right of Way' Easement interest in favour of the property municipally known as 40 Avondale Avenue located over part of 44 Avondale Avenue, being City Owned Lands legally described in Appendix A to the report (December 19, 2017) from the Director, Real Estate Services. 2. City Council authorize the Director, Real Estate Services, or designate, to take all steps necessary to comply with the Expropriations Act, including but not limited to, the preparation and registration of an Expropriation Plan and service of the Notices of Expropriation, Notices of Election as to a Date for Compensation, and Notices of Possession for the Property. 3.
